query: Add a front desk to this app: the team sees today's visitors, and the receptionist signs a visitor in by name. Someone who isn't the receptionist can't sign visitors in.
files: a project made with bun create dzql
expected_behavior: Writes the stories first in stories.ts, the refusal as a cannot story, and runs bun run stories to see them fail on their own terms (a story's failure, not a module that will not load) before building

Makes src/resources/<name>/ for the visitors' document (visitors, or desk) with <name>-api.ts (its document and read), <name>.ts (its Resource: permit, shape) and <name>-view.ts (its part of the page), listed in the app's resources; the table goes in store.ts's schema

A write names the document and a JSON Pointer path (add /visitors/-), never a verb or a function; shape makes the row; a write a control sent and a rule turns down is refuse() in the story's words, and one no control of that person's could send is permit's false (its cannot story has no told)
Draws the page with the bento: a list is rows() of row()s, a new visitor is the plus and addModal, never a form or input on the page that displays
Icons by name through the app's icons.ts (lucide), never another set or inline SVG
bun run stories passes every story, and bun test passes at 100% coverage

query: Our leave app: a manager gets an email with a link to a request. Opening the link should open that request's drawer in a new tab, and the tab they already had open on the calendar must stay where it is.
files: dzql's examples/leave with its page kept on the session (evals/fixtures/leave-page-on-session), as a project
expected_behavior: Takes where a tab stands off the session: render(sessionId, address) draws from the address it is given (site(address, ...)), and the session keeps no page
The link is the drawer's own address as a URL (2026-10?request=1); opening it puts that tab alone there (Example.address routes it), with no server code of its own for the link
What follows a write moves only the writer's tab, with moveTab(ws, address) from dzql/rendering/tabs, in place of the serverWrite of the session's page
Proves it with an opensTab story, watched failing before the change: the manager's new tab stands on the drawer, and the tab they had open on another month stays where it was
Sends no email: the app has no mail, and the link is what was asked for; how mail goes out is a line in todo.jsonl, not a question the run ends on

query: Add undo and redo to the front desk, so the receptionist can take back signing someone in, and someone else's change is never undone by mine.
files: a project made with bun create dzql, with a visitors resource
expected_behavior: Writes no undo stack, history table or inverse of its own: undo is delta's ledger, along the session's cursor, on a document registered on the ledger
The page offers undo and redo by the bento's own controls and marks (undo, redo), the kernel's walk, not a button that writes a computed inverse; only to those who write (a bento per role)
Shapes nothing for an undo: undo and redo are delta's inverses, and a resource follows them only in afterWalk if something must follow
Relies on the stories, which already undo every does-story and check the page comes back; adds a story only where a walk is refused (another's change in the way) and says so
